label: ZKN_SCARLET_0001_000
text:
For some time after its birth, it uses the nutrients
that are packed into the seed on its back in order
to grow.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0002_000
text:
The more sunlight Ivysaur bathes in, the more
strength wells up within it, allowing the bud
on its back to grow larger.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0003_000
text:
While it basks in the sun, it can convert the
light into energy. As a result, it is more
powerful in the summertime.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0004_000
text:
The flame on its tail shows the strength of its
life-force. If Charmander is weak, the flame
also burns weakly.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0005_000
text:
When it swings its burning tail, the temperature
around it rises higher and higher, tormenting its
opponents.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0006_000
text:
If Charizard becomes truly angered, the flame
at the tip of its tail burns in a light blue shade.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0007_000
text:
After birth, its back swells and hardens into a
shell. It sprays a potent foam from its mouth.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0008_000
text:
Wartortle’s long, furry tail is a symbol of
longevity, so this Pokémon is quite popular
among older people.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0009_000
text:
It deliberately increases its body weight so
it can withstand the recoil of the water jets
it fires.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0023_000
text:
It can freely detach its jaw to swallow large
prey whole. It can become too heavy to move,
however.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0024_000
text:
The pattern on its belly appears to be a
frightening face. Weak foes will flee just
at the sight of the pattern.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0025_000
text:
When it is angered, it immediately discharges the
energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0025_001
text:
The cap this Pikachu wears is filled with memories
of this Pokémon and its partner traveling across
lots of different regions together.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0025_002
text:
The cap this Pikachu wears is filled with memories
of this Pokémon and its partner traveling across
the Hoenn region together.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0025_003
text:
The cap this Pikachu wears is filled with memories
of this Pokémon and its partner traveling across
the Sinnoh region together.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0025_004
text:
The cap this Pikachu wears is filled with memories
of this Pokémon and its partner traveling across
the Unova region together.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0025_005
text:
The cap this Pikachu wears is filled with memories
of this Pokémon and its partner traveling across
the Kalos region together.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0025_006
text:
The cap this Pikachu wears is filled with memories
of this Pokémon and its partner traveling across
the Alola region together.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0025_007
text:
The cap this Pikachu wears is filled with memories
of this Pokémon traveling together with its
partner, whom it met in a fateful encounter.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0025_009
text:
The cap this Pikachu wears is filled with memories
of this Pokémon and its partner traveling across
the world together.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0026_000
text:
Its tail discharges electricity into the ground,
protecting it from getting shocked.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0027_000
text:
It digs deep burrows to live in. When in danger,
it rolls up its body to withstand attacks.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0027_001
text:
It lives on snowy mountains. Its steel shell is
very hard—so much so, it can’t roll its body up
into a ball.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0028_000
text:
It is adept at attacking with the spines on its back
and its sharp claws while quickly scurrying about.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0028_001
text:
This Pokémon’s steel spikes are sheathed
in ice. Stabs from these spikes cause deep
wounds and severe frostbite as well.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0035_000
text:
On nights with a full moon, Clefairy gather from
all over and dance. Bathing in moonlight makes
them float.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0036_000
text:
Said to live in quiet, remote mountains, this type
of fairy has a strong aversion to being seen.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0037_000
text:
If it is attacked by an enemy that is stronger
than itself, it feigns injury to fool the enemy
and escapes.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0037_001
text:
They live together in a skulk, helping one another.
Before eating their prey, they freeze it solid with
their −58 degree Fahrenheit breath.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0038_000
text:
Some legends claim that each of its nine tails has
its own unique type of special mystical power.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0038_001
text:
Possessing a calm demeanor, this Pokémon was
revered as a deity incarnate before it was
identified as a regional variant of Ninetales.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0039_000
text:
When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously
soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0040_000
text:
It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it
angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a
body slam.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0043_000
text:
Its scientific name is Oddium wanderus. It is said
to cover distances as far as 1,000 feet when
night falls, walking on its two roots.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0044_000
text:
The fluid that oozes from its mouth isn’t drool.
It is a nectar that is used to attract prey.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0045_000
text:
The bud bursts into bloom with a bang. It then
starts scattering allergenic, poisonous pollen.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0048_000
text:
Poison oozes from all over its body. It catches
small bug Pokémon at night that are attracted
by light.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0049_000
text:
The wings are covered with dustlike scales. Every
time it flaps its wings, it looses highly toxic dust.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0050_000
text:
It lives about one yard underground, where it
feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears
aboveground.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0050_001
text:
The things growing from its head are whiskers
that have become metallic. Diglett communicates
with its comrades by waving them.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0051_000
text:
Its three heads bob separately up and down to
loosen the soil nearby, making it easier for it
to burrow.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0051_001
text:
Its shining gold whiskers are advanced sensors
that can detect vibrations from sounds several
miles away.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0052_000
text:
All it does is sleep during the daytime. At night,
it patrols its territory with its eyes aglow.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0053_000
text:
Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to
raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0054_000
text:
It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the
headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious
powers.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0055_000
text:
When it swims at full speed using its long,
webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins
to glow.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0056_000
text:
It lives in groups in the treetops. If it loses sight of
its group, it becomes infuriated by its loneliness.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0057_000
text:
It becomes wildly furious if it even senses
someone looking at it. It chases anyone
that meets its glare.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0058_000
text:
It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly
stands up to bigger and stronger foes.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0059_000
text:
An ancient picture scroll shows that people
were captivated by its movement as it ran
through prairies.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0060_000
text:
The swirl on its belly is its insides showing
through the skin. It appears more clearly after
Poliwag eats.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0061_000
text:
Its two legs are well developed. Even though it
can live on the ground, it prefers living in water.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0062_000
text:
Although it’s skilled in a style of dynamic
swimming that uses all its muscles, for some
reason it lives on dry land.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0069_000
text:
No matter what Bellsprout is doing, if it detects
movement nearby, it will immediately react by
reaching out with its thin vines.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0070_000
text:
Even though it is filled with acid, it does not melt
because it also oozes a protective fluid.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0071_000
text:
It lures prey into its mouth with a nectar-like
aroma. The helpless prey is melted with a
dissolving fluid.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0072_000
text:
When the tide goes out, dehydrated Tentacool
can be found left behind on the shore.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0073_000
text:
On the rare occasions that large outbreaks of
Tentacruel occur, all fish Pokémon disappear
from the surrounding sea.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0074_000
text:
At rest, it looks just like a rock. Carelessly
stepping on it will make it swing its fists angrily.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0074_001
text:
Its body is a magnetic stone. Iron sand attaches
firmly to the portions of its body that are
particularly magnetic.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0075_000
text:
A slow walker, it rolls to move. It pays no
attention to any object that happens to be
in its path.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0075_001
text:
They eat rocks and often get into a scrap over
them. The impact of Graveler smashing together
causes a flash of light and a booming noise.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0076_000
text:
It is enclosed in a hard shell that is as rugged
as slabs of rock. It sheds skin once a year to
grow larger.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0076_001
text:
It’s grumpy and stubborn. If you upset it, it
discharges electricity from the surface of its
body and growls with a voice like thunder.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0079_000
text:
It is incredibly slow and dopey. It takes five
seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0079_001
text:
It gives off a stimulating scent because of
chemicals that have seeped into its body from
the spice that it eats as its staple food.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0080_000
text:
When a Slowpoke went hunting in the sea, its tail
was bitten by a Shellder. That made it evolve
into Slowbro.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0080_002
text:
Shellder seems blissful over the taste of Slowbro
even though the toxins seeping from the bite
have caused Shellder to faint.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0081_000
text:
The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units
at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which
allows it to float.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0082_000
text:
Three Magnemite are linked by a strong magnetic
force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0084_000
text:
Its twin heads have exactly the same genes and
battle in perfect sync with each other.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0085_000
text:
It now has three hearts and three sets of lungs.
Though it can’t run as fast as Doduo, Dodrio can
keep running for longer stretches of time.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0086_000
text:
The protrusion on its head is very hard. It is
used for bashing through thick ice.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0087_000
text:
It sleeps under shallow ocean waters during
the day, then looks for food at night when
it’s colder.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0088_000
text:
Born from sludge, these Pokémon now gather
in polluted places and increase the bacteria in
their bodies.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0088_001
text:
They store their toxins inside their bodies, so
unlike Grimer from other regions, they don’t
smell bad even up close.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0089_000
text:
It’s thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is
so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0089_001
text:
There are over a hundred kinds of poison
inside its body. Chemical reactions between
different poisons are the source of its vitality.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0090_000
text:
It is encased in a shell that is harder than diamond.
Inside, however, it is surprisingly tender.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0091_000
text:
Cloyster that live in seas with harsh tidal currents
grow large, sharp spikes on their shells.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0092_000
text:
It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body,
slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it
through the skin.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0093_000
text:
It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders
with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless
shuddering.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0094_000
text:
To steal the life of its target, it slips into the prey’s
shadow and silently waits for an opportunity.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0096_000
text:
It remembers every dream it eats. It rarely eats
the dreams of adults because children’s are much
tastier.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0097_000
text:
When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use
a mix of psi moves, such as Hypnosis and
Confusion.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0100_000
text:
It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden
jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0101_000
text:
The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets.
But this also makes it more likely to explode.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0102_000
text:
If you touch one of Exeggcute’s heads,
mistaking it for an egg, the other heads will
quickly gather and attack you in a swarm.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0103_000
text:
It is called the Walking Jungle. Each of the nuts
has a face and a will of its own.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0103_001
text:
It swings its long neck like a whip and smacks its
head into opponents. This makes Exeggutor itself
a little dizzy too.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0106_000
text:
At the exact moment it lands a kick on its target,
Hitmonlee hardens the muscles on the sole of its
foot, maximizing the power of the kick.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0107_000
text:
It corners its foes with combo punches from both
sides, then finishes them off with a single straight
punch launched at over 300 mph.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0109_000
text:
Toxic gas is held within its thin, balloon-shaped
body, so it can cause massive explosions.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0110_000
text:
Top-grade perfume is made using its internal
poison gases by diluting them to the highest
level.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0111_000
text:
Rhyhorn claims an area with over a six mile radius
as its territory. It apparently forgets where this
territory is when running, however.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0112_000
text:
The horn of a Rhydon is powerful enough
to crush raw diamonds. These Pokémon polish
their horns by bashing them together.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0113_000
text:
This kindly Pokémon lays highly nutritious eggs
and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0116_000
text:
If attacked—even by a large enemy—Horsea
effortlessly swims to safety by utilizing its
well-developed dorsal fin.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0117_000
text:
The male raises the young. If it is approached
while caring for young, it will use its toxic spines
to fend off the intruder.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0123_000
text:
It slashes through grass with its sharp scythes,
moving too fast for the human eye to track.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0125_000
text:
Its body constantly discharges electricity.
Getting close to it will make your hair stand
on end.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0126_000
text:
Found near the mouth of a volcano. This
fire-breather’s body temperature is nearly
2,200 degrees Fahrenheit.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0128_000
text:
When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously
while whipping its body with its long tails.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0128_001
text:
This Pokémon has a muscular body and excels at
close-quarters combat. It uses its short horns to
strike the opponent’s weak spots.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0128_002
text:
When heated by fire energy, its horns can get
hotter than 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. Those
gored by them will suffer both wounds and burns.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0128_003
text:
This Pokémon blasts water from holes on the tips
of its horns—the high-pressure jets pierce right
through Tauros’s enemies.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0129_000
text:
An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may
jump high on rare occasions but never more
than seven feet.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0130_000
text:
Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains
enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0131_000
text:
It ferries people across the sea on its back. It may
sing an enchanting cry if it is in a good mood.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0132_000
text:
Its transformation ability is perfect. However,
if made to laugh, it can’t maintain its disguise.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0133_000
text:
Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to
adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0134_000
text:
It lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a
fin, which is often mistaken for a mermaid’s.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0135_000
text:
It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted
by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0136_000
text:
Inhaled air is carried to its flame sac, heated, and
exhaled as fire that reaches over 3,000 degrees
Fahrenheit.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0137_000
text:
It is an artificial Pokémon. Since it doesn’t
breathe, people are excited by its potential
to be useful in any environment.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0143_000
text:
This gluttonous Pokémon eats constantly, apart
from when it’s asleep. It devours nearly 900
pounds of food per day.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0147_000
text:
It sheds many layers of skin as it grows larger.
During this process, it is protected by a rapid
waterfall.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0148_000
text:
They say that if it emits an aura from its whole
body, the weather will begin to change instantly.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0149_000
text:
It is said that somewhere in the ocean lies an
island where these gather. Only they live there.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0152_000
text:
It loves to bask in the sunlight. It uses the leaf on
its head to seek out warm places.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0153_000
text:
The spicy scent that wafts from around Bayleef’s
neck somehow makes those who smell it want to
fight.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0154_000
text:
Anyone who stands beside it becomes
refreshed, just as if they were soaking in
the soothing atmosphere of a forest.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0155_000
text:
It usually stays hunched over. If it is angry or
surprised, it shoots flames out of its back.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0156_000
text:
Before battle, it turns its back on its opponent
to demonstrate how ferociously its fire blazes.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0157_000
text:
It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its
blazing fur to cause huge explosions.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0158_000
text:
Its powerful, well-developed jaws are capable
of crushing anything. Even its Trainer must be
careful.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0159_000
text:
The tips of its fangs are slanted backward.
Once those fangs clamp down, the prey has
no hope of escape.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0160_000
text:
When it bites with its massive and
powerful jaws, it shakes its head and
savagely tears its victim up.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0161_000
text:
This Pokémon is extremely cautious. Its supple
tail is well muscled and firm to the touch.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0162_000
text:
It raises its offspring inside a long, narrow nest.
Once they’re old enough, it takes them outside
the nest to prepare them for independence.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0163_000
text:
Hoothoot’s internal clock is precise at all times.
It tilts its head in a fixed rhythm.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0164_000
text:
Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate
even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0167_000
text:
Even while there are prey ensnared in its nest of
spun thread, Spinarak will wait motionlessly until
darkness falls.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0168_000
text:
A single strand of a special thread is endlessly
spun out of its rear. The thread leads back to
its nest.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0170_000
text:
It lives in ocean depths beyond the reach
of sunlight. It flashes lights on its antennae
to communicate with others of its kind.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0171_000
text:
Portions of its dorsal fin mutated, becoming the
parts that glow brightly to lure prey.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0172_000
text:
It is unskilled at storing electric power.
Any kind of shock causes it to discharge
energy spontaneously.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0173_000
text:
On late nights illuminated by shooting stars, it
gazes intently skyward, as if thinking of its home.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0174_000
text:
Its body has a faintly sweet scent and is bouncy
and soft. If it bounces even once, it cannot stop.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0179_000
text:
If static electricity builds in its body, its fleece
doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0180_000
text:
As a result of storing too much electricity,
it developed patches where even downy
wool won’t grow.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0181_000
text:
The bright light on its tail can be seen far
away. It has been treasured since ancient
times as a beacon.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0182_000
text:
Due to the effects of the Sun Stone, it is now
active during the daytime. It likes to dance in
pools of sunlight.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0183_000
text:
The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can
stay dry even when it plays in the water.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0184_000
text:
Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish
the movements of things in water and tell what
they are.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0185_000
text:
Although it always pretends to be a tree,
its composition appears more similar to
rock than to vegetation.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0186_000
text:
If Poliwag and Poliwhirl hear its echoing cry, they
respond by gathering from far and wide.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0187_000
text:
This Pokémon is blown across vast distances
by the wind. It is unclear where the Hoppip of
Paldea originally came from.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0188_000
text:
Skiploom enthusiasts can apparently tell where a
Skiploom was born by the scent drifting from the
flower on the Pokémon’s head.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0189_000
text:
Jumpluff travels on seasonal winds. Once its
cotton spores run out, its journey ends, as does
its life.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0190_000
text:
It lives atop tall trees. When leaping from branch
to branch, it deftly uses its tail for balance.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0191_000
text:
It suddenly falls out of the sky in the morning.
Knowing it’s weak, it simply feeds until it evolves.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0192_000
text:
In the daytime, it rushes about in a hectic
manner, but it comes to a complete stop when
the sun sets.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0193_000
text:
As Yanma surveys its territory, it periodically
stops to hover in place by flapping its wings at
high speeds.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0194_000
text:
A transparent mucous membrane covers its body.
Touching it bare-handed will cause a tingling
numbness.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0194_001
text:
After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began
living on land. The Pokémon changed over time,
developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0195_000
text:
This carefree Pokémon has an easygoing nature.
While swimming, it always bumps into boat hulls.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0196_000
text:
The tip of its forked tail quivers when it is
predicting its opponent’s next move.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0197_000
text:
When exposed to the moon’s aura, the rings on
its body glow faintly and it gains a mysterious
power.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0198_000
text:
Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to
bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0199_000
text:
When its head was bitten, toxins entered
Slowpoke’s head and unlocked an extraordinary
power.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0199_001
text:
It administers its potions to weakened Pokémon
it sees. These potions are derived from poison
and secreted from holes in Slowking’s horns.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0200_000
text:
This Pokémon startles people in the middle of
the night. It gathers fear as its energy.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0203_000
text:
Though very small, the brain in its tail is still
considered an important organ because it emits
powerful psychic energy.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0204_000
text:
It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers
of tree bark. The additional weight doesn’t
bother it.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0205_000
text:
It’s usually found hanging on to a fat tree trunk.
It shoots out bits of its shell when it sees action.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0206_000
text:
It creates mazes in dark locations. When spotted,
it flees into the ground by digging with its tail.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0207_000
text:
It builds its nest on a steep cliff. When it is done
gliding, it hops along the ground back to its nest.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0209_000
text:
In truth, it is a cowardly Pokémon. It growls
eagerly in order to hide its fear from its
opponent.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0210_000
text:
It is actually timid and easily spooked.
If attacked, it desperately flails its limbs
about in an attempt to repel its opponent.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0211_000
text:
Be cautious if this Pokémon starts sucking in
water—it will soon attack by scattering the toxic
spikes that grow all over its body.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0212_000
text:
This Pokémon’s pincers, which contain steel, can
crush any hard object they get ahold of into bits.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0214_000
text:
It loves sweet nectar. To keep all the nectar to
itself, it hurls rivals away with its prized horn.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0215_000
text:
This cunning Pokémon hides under the cover of
darkness, waiting to attack its prey.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0216_000
text:
This Pokémon discreetly follows Combee to find
their hive. It scoops up big dollops of honey in its
palms to eat.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0217_000
text:
It usually wears a hardened expression, but when
it’s licking up honey—which it loves—the joy it
feels will cause it to break into a wide grin.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0218_000
text:
Its lava body can cool and chip away at times,
but a magma bath will heal it right up.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0219_000
text:
This Pokémon lives near the craters of volcanoes.
It stores fire energy in its shell of cooled and
hardened magma.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0220_000
text:
It searches for food by digging into the ground
with its snout. Even frozen ground doesn’t give it
any trouble.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0221_000
text:
Covered by a shaggy coat, it is resistant to the
cold. Its tusks of ice thicken when it snows.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0225_000
text:
It carries food all day long. There are tales about
lost people who were saved by the food it had.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0227_000
text:
Its sturdy, heavy-looking iron body is actually thin
and light, so it can fly at speeds over 180 mph.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0228_000
text:
It is smart enough to hunt in packs. It uses a
variety of cries for communicating with others.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0229_000
text:
If you are burned by the flames it shoots from its
mouth, the pain will never go away.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0230_000
text:
It sleeps deep on the ocean floor to build its
energy. It is said to cause tornadoes as it wakes.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0231_000
text:
This Pokémon lives and nests on a riverbank.
After playing in the mud, it won’t be able to
settle down unless it washes its body.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0232_000
text:
Donphan is covered in tough hide, so even being
hit by a car won’t faze this Pokémon. However, it
is extremely susceptible to rain.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0233_000
text:
This artificial Pokémon evolved thanks to cutting-
edge science. It sometimes displays behavior that
is not in its programming.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0234_000
text:
This Pokémon apparently used to live in much
harsher environments, and thus it once had
stronger psychic powers than it does now.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0235_000
text:
Once a Smeargle reaches adulthood, it will have
other members of its species leave paw prints on
its back.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0236_000
text:
This earnest Pokémon battles all sorts of
opponents, searching for the fighting style
that suits it best.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0237_000
text:
This Pokémon is adept at dance-like kicks.
The horn atop its head is made from the same
substance that generally forms fur and claws.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0239_000
text:
It loves violent thunder. The space between its
horns flickers bluish white when it is charging
energy.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0240_000
text:
Each and every time it inhales and exhales,
sparks leak from its mouth and nostrils.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0242_000
text:
Anyone who takes even one taste of Blissey’s
egg becomes unfailingly caring and pleasant
to everyone.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0246_000
text:
Born deep underground, this Pokémon becomes
a pupa after eating enough dirt to make a
mountain.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0247_000
text:
This pupa flies around wildly by venting with
great force the gas pressurized inside its body.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0248_000
text:
Extremely strong, it can change the landscape.
It is so insolent that it doesn’t care about others.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0252_000
text:
The small hooks on the soles of its feet latch
on to walls and ceilings, so it will never fall even
while hanging upside down.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0253_000
text:
Its strongly developed thigh muscles give it
astounding agility and jumping performance.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0254_000
text:
It agilely flits through the jungle and uses the
sharp-edged leaves on its arms to cut down its
prey.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0255_000
text:
Torchic feels toasty warm if you hug it. It has a
flame sac inside its belly, and the flames burn
continuously as long as Torchic has life in it.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0256_000
text:
It boosts its concentration by emitting harsh cries.
Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0257_000
text:
When facing a tough foe, it looses flames from
its wrists. Its powerful legs let it jump clear over
buildings.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0258_000
text:
It has the power to crush large boulders into
pieces. To rest, it buries itself in mud at the
bottom of a river.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0259_000
text:
Living on muddy ground that provides poor
footing has served to train its lower body
and caused it to develop sturdy legs.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0260_000
text:
Its arms are hard as rock. With one swing, it can
break an enormous boulder into pieces.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0261_000
text:
It bares its large fangs and barks vigorously to
try to intimidate opponents, but this is actually
a manifestation of its cowardly nature.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0262_000
text:
They faithfully follow the orders of their leader.
Prey targeted by Mightyena is never allowed to
escape the outstanding teamwork of its pursuers.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0270_000
text:
The leaf on its head is naturally dirt repellent
and will stay clean even after transporting
Pokémon that are covered in mud.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0271_000
text:
Old folklore in Kitakami tells of a mischievous
child who was reborn as a Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0272_000
text:
There are structures throughout its whole body
that produce energy when hit by sound waves
with a cheerful rhythm.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0273_000
text:
To expand its habitat, it pretends to be a nut so
that bird Pokémon will pick it up and carry it far
away.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0274_000
text:
It leads a quiet life deep in the forest. If anything
wanders into its territory, Nuzleaf will warn the
intruder by sounding its grass flute.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0275_000
text:
It is said that when Shiftry flaps its leafy fans
atop ancient trees, chilly winds blow and the
season rolls into winter.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0278_000
text:
It soars high in the sky, riding on updrafts like a
glider. It carries food tucked in its bill.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0279_000
text:
It is a flying transporter that carries small
Pokémon in its beak. It bobs on the waves to
rest its wings.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0280_000
text:
The horns on its head provide a strong power
that enables it to sense people’s emotions.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0281_000
text:
It has a psychic power that enables it to distort
the space around it and see into the future.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0282_000
text:
To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic
power to create a small black hole.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0283_000
text:
They usually live on ponds, but after an evening
shower, they may appear on puddles in towns.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0284_000
text:
It flaps its four wings to hover and fly freely in
any direction—to and fro and sideways.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0285_000
text:
It prefers damp places. By day it remains still
in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder
from its head.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0286_000
text:
It scatters poisonous spores and throws
powerful punches while its foe is hampered
by inhaled spores.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0287_000
text:
It sleeps for 20 hours every day. Making drowsy
those that see it is one of its abilities.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0288_000
text:
Its stress level rises if it cannot keep moving
constantly. Too much stress makes it feel sick.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0289_000
text:
It is the world’s most slothful Pokémon. However,
it can exert horrifying power by releasing pent-up
energy all at once.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0296_000
text:
It grows stronger by enduring harsh training. It is
a gutsy Pokémon that can withstand any attack.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0297_000
text:
It loves challenging others to tests of strength.
It has the power to stop a train with a slap.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0298_000
text:
Its tail bounces like a rubber ball. It flings that tail
around to fight opponents bigger than itself.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0299_000
text:
The magnet in Nosepass’s nose provides an
unerring compass, making this Pokémon an
excellent partner for Trainers going on a journey.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0302_000
text:
It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp
claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0307_000
text:
It never skips its daily yoga training. It heightens
its inner strength through meditation.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0308_000
text:
Through yoga training, it gained the psychic
power to predict its foe’s next move.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0311_000
text:
It cheers on partners while scattering sparks from
its body. It climbs telephone poles to absorb
electricity.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0312_000
text:
Exposure to electricity from Minun and Plusle
promotes blood circulation and relaxes muscles.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0313_000
text:
It lives around clean ponds. At night, its rear
lights up. It converses with others by flashing
its light.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0314_000
text:
Illumise uses its sweet scent to guide Volbeat,
having them form over 200 patterns in the
night sky.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0316_000
text:
There is nothing its stomach can’t digest.
While it is digesting, vile, overpowering gases
are expelled.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0317_000
text:
It gulps anything that fits in its mouth. Its special
enzymes can dissolve anything.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0322_000
text:
Magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit
courses through its body. When it grows cold,
the magma hardens and slows it.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0323_000
text:
It lives in the crater of a volcano. It is well known
that the humps on its back erupt every 10 years.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0324_000
text:
It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows
out black soot if it is endangered.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0325_000
text:
Spoink will die if it stops bouncing. The pearl on
its head amplifies its psychic powers.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0326_000
text:
It can perform odd dance steps to influence
foes. Its style of dancing became hugely
popular overseas.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0328_000
text:
This Pokémon lives in arid deserts.
It patiently awaits prey inside its funnel-
shaped nest.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0329_000
text:
Rather than using its underdeveloped wings for
flight, it rubs them together, emitting ultrasonic
waves to attack its enemies.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0330_000
text:
Known as the Desert Spirit, this Pokémon hides in
the sandstorms it causes by beating its wings.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0331_000
text:
It prefers harsh environments, such as deserts.
It can survive for 30 days on water stored in
its body.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0332_000
text:
Packs of them follow travelers through the desert
until the travelers can no longer move.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0333_000
text:
It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes
a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0334_000
text:
If it bonds with a person, it will gently envelop
the friend with its soft wings, then hum.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0335_000
text:
It’s Seviper’s archrival. To threaten those
it encounters, it fans out the claws on its
front paws.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0336_000
text:
It sharpens its swordlike tail on hard rocks.
It hides in tall grass and strikes unwary prey
with venomous fangs.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0339_000
text:
Its two whiskers provide a sensitive radar. Even in
muddy waters, it can detect its prey’s location.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0340_000
text:
It is extremely protective of its territory. If any
foe approaches, it attacks using vicious tremors.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0341_000
text:
It came from overseas. It is a very hardy creature
that will quickly proliferate, even in polluted
streams.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0342_000
text:
Loving to battle, this Pokémon pinches all
Pokémon that enter its territory with its
pincers and throws them out.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0349_000
text:
This tough Pokémon is perfectly fine even in
dirty water. However, due to its ragged, shabby
appearance, it isn’t popular.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0350_000
text:
Its lovely scales are described as rainbow-
colored. They change color depending on
the viewing angle.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0353_000
text:
It loves to feed on feelings like envy and malice.
Its upright horn catches the emotions of people.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0354_000
text:
This Pokémon developed from an abandoned
doll that amassed a grudge. It is seen in dark
alleys.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0355_000
text:
In the dead of night, these Pokémon wander
through towns in search of children, whose
vital energy is a Duskull’s favorite food.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0356_000
text:
Dusclops is feared because it’s said to pull the
soul out of anyone who gazes upon the strange
movements of its hands.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0357_000
text:
It lives in tropical jungles. The bunch of fruit
around its neck is delicious. The fruit grows
twice a year.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0358_000
text:
It uses the sucker on its head to hang from a tree
or from eaves. It can produce seven different
tones.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0361_000
text:
It is said that several Snorunt gather under giant
leaves and live together in harmony.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0362_000
text:
Its prey is instantaneously frozen stiff by the cold
air it exhales from its huge mouth. While they’re
in that frozen state, it gobbles them up.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0370_000
text:
Its heart-shaped body makes it popular. In some
places, you would give a Luvdisc to someone
you love.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0371_000
text:
Its steel-hard head can shatter boulders.
It longingly hopes for wings to grow so it can fly.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0372_000
text:
The cells within its shell transform with explosive
speed, preparing it for evolution.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0373_000
text:
It flies around on its wings, which have grown in
at last. In its happiness, it gushes hot flames,
burning up everything it passes over.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0374_000
text:
The magnetic force generated by its body repels
the ground’s natural magnetism, letting it float.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0375_000
text:
It is formed by two Beldum joining
together. Its two brains are linked,
amplifying its psychic power.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0376_000
text:
It folds its four legs when flying. Its
four brains are said to be superior to
a supercomputer.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0387_000
text:
The shell on its back is made of soil. If the shell
is moist to the touch, Turtwig is very healthy.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0388_000
text:
Grotle live in the forest. Each is said to have its
own secret place for getting clean springwater.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0389_000
text:
Ancient people imagined that beneath the
ground dwelt a gigantic Torterra.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0390_000
text:
It is very agile. Before going to sleep,
it extinguishes the flame on its tail to
prevent fires.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0391_000
text:
It skillfully controls the intensity of the fire on its
tail to keep its foes at an ideal distance.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0392_000
text:
This Pokémon confounds opponents with its
speed. It uses all its limbs to fight in its own
unique style.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0393_000
text:
A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its
strong pride makes it puff up its chest without
a care.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0394_000
text:
It lives a solitary life. Its wings deliver wicked
blows that can snap even the thickest of trees
in half with a single hit.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0395_000
text:
If anyone were to hurt its pride, it would slash
them in two with wings that can cleave through
an ice floe.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0396_000
text:
They flock around mountains and fields, chasing
after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and
annoying.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0397_000
text:
Recognizing their own weakness, they always live
in a group. When alone, a Staravia cries noisily.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0398_000
text:
When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave
the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0401_000
text:
Its legs are short. Whenever it stumbles, its stiff
antennae clack with a xylophone-like sound.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0402_000
text:
By allowing its cry to resonate in the hollow of its
belly, it produces a captivating sound.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0403_000
text:
The extension and contraction of its muscles
generates electricity. It glows when in trouble.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0404_000
text:
Strong electricity courses through the tips of
its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting
in foes.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0405_000
text:
It can see clearly through walls to track down its
prey and seek its lost young.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0408_000
text:
It lived in jungles around a hundred million years
ago. It used its skillful headbutts to combat
Aerodactyl.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0409_000
text:
Stifled by a thick skull that can withstand any
impact, this Pokémon’s brain never got very big.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0410_000
text:
It is outstandingly armored. As a result, it has no
particular need to battle with others and can
spend its time feeding on grass and berries.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0411_000
text:
While it can guard against any sort of
attack from the front, it is left without
recourse when attacked from behind.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0415_000
text:
At night, Combee sleep in a group of about a
hundred, packed closely together in a lump.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0416_000
text:
It houses its colony in cells in its body and
releases various pheromones to make those
grubs do its bidding.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0417_000
text:
It’s one of the kinds of Pokémon with electric
cheek pouches. It shoots charges from its tail.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0418_000
text:
It spins its two tails like a screw to propel itself
through water. The tails also slice clinging
seaweed.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0419_000
text:
With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people
on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0422_000
text:
It used to have a shell on its back long ago.
This species is closely related to Pokémon
like Shellder.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0422_001
text:
A recently published research paper states that
this form of Shellos is gradually decreasing
in number.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0423_000
text:
Its whole body is sticky with mucus. In the past,
this form of Gastrodon was by far the more
numerous one.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0423_001
text:
They normally inhabit rocky seashores, but in
times of continuous rain, they can sometimes be
found in the mountains, far from the sea.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0424_000
text:
They live on large trees. They are said to
communicate by connecting their tails to
those of others.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0425_000
text:
It is whispered that any child who mistakes
Drifloon for a balloon and holds on to it could
wind up missing.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0426_000
text:
It can generate and release gas within its body.
That’s how it can control the altitude of its drift.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0429_000
text:
Its cry sounds like an incantation. It is said the
cry may rarely be imbued with happiness-giving
power.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0430_000
text:
It is merciless by nature. It is said that it never
forgives the mistakes of its Murkrow followers.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0433_000
text:
There is an orb inside its mouth. When it hops,
the orb bounces all over and makes a ringing
sound.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0434_000
text:
It sprays a foul fluid from its rear. Its stench
spreads over a mile radius, driving Pokémon
away.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0435_000
text:
It attacks by spraying a horribly smelly fluid from
the tip of its tail. Attacks from above confound it.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0436_000
text:
Ancient people believed that the pattern on
Bronzor’s back contained a mysterious power.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0437_000
text:
In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as a
bringer of rain. It was found buried in the ground.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0438_000
text:
In order to adjust the level of fluids in its body, it
exudes water from its eyes. This makes it appear
to be crying.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0440_000
text:
It carries a round, white rock in its belly pouch.
If it gets along well with someone, it will
sometimes give that person the rock.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0442_000
text:
Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted
in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a
mysterious spell.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0443_000
text:
It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy
passes by, it leaps out and chomps them.
The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0444_000
text:
In rare cases, it molts and sheds its scales.
Medicine containing its scales as an ingredient
will make a weary body feel invigorated.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0445_000
text:
It is said that when one runs at high speed,
its wings create blades of wind that can fell
nearby trees.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0446_000
text:
It needs to consume its own weight in food every
day. As far as flavor is concerned, it’s indifferent.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0447_000
text:
They communicate with one another using their
auras. They are able to run all through the night.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0448_000
text:
It’s said that no foe can remain invisible to
Lucario, since it can detect auras—even those
of foes it could not otherwise see.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0449_000
text:
It shuts its nostrils tight, then travels through sand
as if walking. They form colonies of around 10.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0450_000
text:
It is surprisingly quick to anger. It holds its mouth
agape as a display of its strength.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0453_000
text:
Inflating its poison sacs, it fills the area with an
odd sound and hits flinching opponents with a
poison jab.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0454_000
text:
Swaying and dodging the attacks of its foes, it
weaves its flexible body in close, then lunges
out with its poisonous claws.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0456_000
text:
The line running down its side can store sunlight.
It shines vividly at night.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0457_000
text:
With its shining light, it lures its prey close.
However, the light also happens to attract
ferocious fish Pokémon—its natural predators.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0459_000
text:
During cold seasons, it migrates to the
mountain’s lower reaches. It returns to the
snow-covered summit in the spring.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0460_000
text:
It lives a quiet life on mountains that are
perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself
by whipping up blizzards.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0461_000
text:
Evolution made it even more devious.
It communicates by clawing signs in boulders.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0462_000
text:
As it zooms through the sky, this Pokémon seems
to be receiving signals of unknown origin while
transmitting signals of unknown purpose.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0464_000
text:
This Pokémon’s sturdy carapace protects
it from volcanic eruptions. It shoots round
rocks from the holes in its hands.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0466_000
text:
When it gets excited, it thumps its chest.
With every thud, thunder roars and electric
sparks shower all around.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0467_000
text:
When shooting 3,600 degree Fahrenheit
fireballs from its arms, its body takes on a
whitish hue from the intense heat.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0469_000
text:
Yanmega’s wingbeats are so powerful that the
Pokémon blows down huge trees nearby when
it vigorously launches itself into flight.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0470_000
text:
When you see Leafeon asleep in a patch of
sunshine, you’ll know it is using photosynthesis
to produce clean air.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0471_000
text:
It can control its body temperature at will.
This enables it to freeze the moisture in the
atmosphere, creating flurries of diamond dust.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0472_000
text:
If it succeeds in catching even a faint breeze
properly, it can circle the globe without flapping
once.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0473_000
text:
A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating
back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been
around a long, long, long time.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0474_000
text:
An additional program was installed to create a
more advanced Pokémon, but it was apparently
flawed. Porygon-Z moves oddly as a result.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0475_000
text:
When trying to protect someone, it extends its
elbows as if they were swords and fights savagely.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0476_000
text:
It controls three units called Mini-Noses using
magnetic force. With them, it can attack a foe
from three directions.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0477_000
text:
It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body
and take them to the afterlife.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0478_000
text:
When it finds humans or Pokémon it likes,
it freezes them and takes them to its chilly
den, where they become decorations.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0479_000
text:
Its electricity-like body can enter some kinds
of machines and take control in order to make
mischief.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0479_001
text:
If the convection microwave oven is not working
properly, then the Rotom inhabiting it will
become lethargic.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0479_002
text:
This Rotom has entered a washing machine.
It nods with satisfaction after it floods the
surrounding area.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0479_003
text:
This Rotom has entered a refrigerator. It leaps
around gleefully after it uses cold air to freeze
the area around it.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0479_004
text:
This Rotom has entered an electric fan. It smirks
with satisfaction over a prank well pulled after it
blows away everything around it.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0479_005
text:
The lawn mower is one of the household
appliances that led to the development of
the Rotom Dex.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0495_000
text:
The leaf on Snivy’s tail generates energy when
exposed to sunlight, making Snivy swifter and
adding an edge to its moves.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0496_000
text:
It runs low to the ground, weaving through the
grass, then mercilessly pummels its target by
whipping them with its vines.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0497_000
text:
It generates energy from sunlight, then
amplifies that energy dozens of times
within its long body.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0498_000
text:
It’s more nimble than it looks, and it uses its
speed to confound its enemies. It rapidly
launches fireballs from both nostrils.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0499_000
text:
When Pignite enters battle, its body temperature
rapidly soars until Pignite itself is engulfed by a
scorching fireball.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0500_000
text:
The flames blazing deep inside Emboar’s
chest erupt vigorously from its chin, forming
a beard of fire.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0501_000
text:
It wields the scalchop on its stomach like a knife,
blocking the moves of its enemies before slashing
back at them in swift retaliation.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0502_000
text:
It’s said that people modeled swordplay after
the way Dewott’s movements flow like water
while it’s wielding its two scalchops.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0503_000
text:
A master of a sword-drawing art called iaijutsu,
Samurott settles its battles with a single swing of
either large sword sheathed in its foreleg armor.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0522_000
text:
Its heartbeat generates electricity. When Blitzle is
surprised and its heart rate goes up, the voltage
of its electricity also rises.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0523_000
text:
This Pokémon is aggressive and has a volatile
disposition. When agitated, it will illuminate its
mane in yellow and fire off bolts of electricity.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0529_000
text:
It can dig through the ground at a speed of
30 mph. It could give a car running aboveground
a good race.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0530_000
text:
Forming a drill with its steel claws and head,
it can bore through a steel plate, no matter
how thick it is.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0532_000
text:
Always carrying squared logs, they help out
with construction. As they grow, they carry
bigger logs.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0533_000
text:
They strengthen their bodies by carrying steel
beams. They show off their big muscles to their
friends.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0534_000
text:
It is thought that Conkeldurr taught humans how
to make concrete more than 2,000 years ago.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0540_000
text:
Sewaddle chews on leaves to make its clothing.
It’s trying to mimic the leafy garment Leavanny
first dressed it in.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0541_000
text:
Swadloon lives quietly at the feet of trees.
It prefers eating fallen leaves that have grown
soft rather than fresh ones.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0542_000
text:
This gentle Pokémon has strong protective
instincts. The leaves on its arms are sharp enough
to slice a thick tree in half with one stroke.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0546_000
text:
Pillows and beds stuffed with cotton exhaled by
Cottonee are soft and puffy, light and airy—
altogether top quality.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0547_000
text:
Like the wind, it can slip through any gap,
no matter how small. It leaves balls of white
fluff behind.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0548_000
text:
The leaves on its head grow right back even if
they fall out. These bitter leaves refresh those
who eat them.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0549_000
text:
The fragrance of the garland on its head has
a relaxing effect, but taking care of it is very
difficult.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0550_000
text:
Its temperament is vicious and aggressive.
This Pokémon is also full of vitality and can
multiply rapidly before anyone notices.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0550_001
text:
These Pokémon form schools with others of the
same color. The greatest foe of a school of blue
Basculin is a school of red Basculin.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0550_002
text:
They live in frigid seas, forming schools and
sharing food among themselves. When the time
comes, they return to the river they were born in.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0551_000
text:
It submerges itself in sand and moves as if
swimming. This wise behavior keeps its enemies
from finding it and maintains its temperature.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0552_000
text:
Protected by thin membranes, their eyes can see
even in the dead of night. They live in groups of
a few individuals.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0553_000
text:
After clamping down with its powerful jaws, it
twists its body around to rip its prey in half.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0559_000
text:
It stretches its saggy skin up to its neck to
protect itself. Among Scraggy, individuals with
saggier skin apparently garner more respect.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0560_000
text:
Groups of them beat up anything that enters
their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from
its mouth.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0570_000
text:
It changes into the forms of others to surprise
them. Apparently, it often transforms into a
silent child.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0571_000
text:
Stories say those who tried to catch Zoroark were
trapped in an illusion and punished.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0572_000
text:
When its tail has gotten dirty from self-cleaning
or from cleaning its nest, Minccino spends a
whole day washing its tail in clean springwater.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0573_000
text:
Their white fur is coated in a special oil that
makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0574_000
text:
This Pokémon is normally very innocent. When it
is staring at something invisible, it is unblinking
and utterly silent.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0575_000
text:
This Pokémon will hypnotize children to put them
to sleep before carrying them away. Be wary of
nights when the starlight is bright.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0576_000
text:
Gothitelle unleashes psychic energy and shows
opponents dreams of the universe’s end. These
dreams are apparently ethereal and beautiful.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0577_000
text:
Because their bodies are enveloped in a special
liquid, they can survive in any environment.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0578_000
text:
Since they have two divided brains, at times
they suddenly try to take two different actions
at once.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0579_000
text:
Their arms are made of a special liquid. They
use psychic power to control these arms and
crush boulders.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0580_000
text:
It’s not very good at flying yet. It watches the
dances of its Swanna parents to learn how to
move its wings.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0581_000
text:
Centered around its leader, the flock dances in
perfect sync to strengthen its unity.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0585_000
text:
Deerling have different scents depending on the
season. In early spring, these Pokémon give off a
delicate, sweet, and calming scent.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0585_001
text:
To prevent Deerling from entering their fields,
many farmers will have several Lycanroc stand
guard, as they are the natural enemy of Deerling.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0585_002
text:
These Pokémon are not shy—they will behave as
they please, even in front of people. If you feed
one of them, it will quickly take a liking to you.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0585_003
text:
Deerling’s scent changes with the seasons, but
when the Pokémon is in its Winter Form, it has
hardly any scent at all.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0586_000
text:
It seems that a Sawsbuck with many flowers on its
antlers will grow at a slightly slower pace because
the flowers absorb the Pokémon’s nutrients.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0586_001
text:
There are many Sawsbuck enthusiasts. The thicker
and larger the branches and leaves on its antlers,
the more majestic the Sawsbuck is thought to be.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0586_002
text:
There are many Sawsbuck enthusiasts. The darker
the red of the foliage that hangs from its antlers,
the more stylish the Sawsbuck is thought to be.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0586_003
text:
It’s said that Sawsbuck are calm and easy to tame
during the season when they take on this form,
so it’s the perfect time to make one your partner.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0590_000
text:
There is a theory that the developer of the
modern-day Poké Ball really liked Foongus,
but this has not been confirmed.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0591_000
text:
Be wary of the poisonous spores it releases.
Mushrooms resembling Amoonguss’s caps will
grow out of anywhere the spores touch.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0594_000
text:
It gently holds injured and weak Pokémon in its
fins. Its special membrane heals their wounds.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0595_000
text:
Joltik that live in cities have learned a technique
for sucking electricity from the outlets in houses.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0596_000
text:
They employ an electrically charged web
to trap their prey. While it is immobilized
by shock, they leisurely consume it.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0602_000
text:
While one alone doesn’t have much power,
a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful
as lightning.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0603_000
text:
They coil around foes and shock them with
electricity-generating organs that seem simply
to be circular patterns.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0604_000
text:
They crawl out of the ocean using their arms.
They will attack prey on shore and immediately
drag it into the ocean.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0607_000
text:
Its flame is usually out, but it starts shining
when Litwick absorbs life-force from people
or Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0608_000
text:
Lampent appears at the moment of death and
promptly absorbs the spirit as it leaves the body.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0609_000
text:
The spirits burned up in its ominous flame lose
their way and wander this world forever.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0610_000
text:
This Pokémon lives in nests that are made in the
ground. People in ancient times used its tusks as
cooking knives.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0611_000
text:
Because its tusks don’t grow back once they
break, this Pokémon apparently won’t use them
unless truly necessary.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0612_000
text:
This Pokémon nests in caves and abandoned
mines. It is docile, but it will become incredibly
angry if its tusks are touched, so beware.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0613_000
text:
Many of this species can be found along the
shorelines of cold regions. If a Cubchoo lacks
dangling snot, there’s a chance it is sick.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0614_000
text:
It is a ferocious, carnivorous Pokémon. Once it
captures its prey, it will breathe cold air onto the
prey to freeze and preserve it.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0615_000
text:
Cryogonal appear during cold seasons. It is said
that people and Pokémon who die on snowy
mountains are reborn into these Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0619_000
text:
In fights, they dominate with onslaughts of
flowing, continuous attacks. With their sharp
claws, they cut enemies.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0620_000
text:
When Mienshao lets out a bizarre wail, you’re in
danger. A flurry of kicks and chops too fast to
see is about to be unleashed!

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0622_000
text:
These Pokémon are thought to have been
created by the science of an ancient and
mysterious civilization.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0623_000
text:
When the seal on its chest is removed, it rages
indiscriminately. During such rampages, it can
turn a whole town into a mountain of rubble.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0624_000
text:
Pawniard will fearlessly challenge even powerful
foes. In a pinch, it will cling to opponents and
pierce them with the blades all over its body.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0625_000
text:
This Pokémon commands a group of several
Pawniard. Groups that are defeated in territorial
disputes are absorbed by the winning side.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0627_000
text:
They pick fights indiscriminately. They grow
stronger and more powerful each time they
faint or are injured.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0628_000
text:
The more scars they have, the more respect these
brave soldiers of the sky get from their peers.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0629_000
text:
They tend to guard their posteriors with suitable
bones they have found. They pursue weak
Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0630_000
text:
It’s always searching for food for Vullaby. When
it finds a weak Pokémon, Mandibuzz swoops it
right off to its nest.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0633_000
text:
It can’t see, so its first approach to examining
things is to bite them. You will be covered in
wounds until a Deino warms up to you.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0634_000
text:
The two heads do not get along at all. If you
don’t give each head the same amount of
attention, they’ll begin fighting out of jealousy.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0635_000
text:
Only the central head has a brain. It is very
intelligent, but it thinks only of destruction.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0636_000
text:
This Pokémon was called the Larva That Stole
the Sun. The fire Larvesta spouts from its horns
can cut right through a sheet of iron.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0637_000
text:
Its burning body causes it to be unpopular in hot
parts of the world, but in cold ones, Volcarona is
revered as an embodiment of the sun.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0650_000
text:
When Chespin tenses up just before landing a
headbutt, the spikes on its head sharpen to
points, piercing the enemy’s body on contact.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0651_000
text:
It’s protected by a sturdy shell. The shell is
also very heavy, which naturally strengthens
Quilladin’s lower body.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0652_000
text:
When its allies are in trouble, Chesnaught
creates a shield with its arms and uses its
own body to block attacks.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0653_000
text:
This Pokémon gets worked up easily. Its body
can also overheat, so it uses its ears to dissipate
the heat and calm down.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0654_000
text:
It ignites the twig from its tail and waves the twig
around to signal its allies. To indicate danger,
it draws circles in the air with the twig’s flame.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0655_000
text:
It leaves burn marks in the ground with the flame
at the tip of its wand. Long ago, people used the
shapes of these burn marks for divination.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0656_000
text:
Its happy-go-lucky look is an act intended to fool
its enemies. It will suddenly drop the facade and
overwhelm its foes with its blinding speed.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0657_000
text:
It excels at devising battle strategies that make
use of the terrain, and it never misses its mark
when throwing bubble-covered pebbles.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0658_000
text:
The movement of air against the long tongue
Greninja keeps wrapped around its neck allows
it to sense enemies it can’t see.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0661_000
text:
This Pokémon is normally calm, but once it enters
battle, its hormonal balance changes and it
becomes aggressive.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0662_000
text:
Fletchinder scatters embers in tall grass where
bug Pokémon might be hiding and then catches
them as they come leaping out.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0663_000
text:
It has top-notch flying capabilities. It flies around
easily, even while carrying prey that weighs more
than 220 lbs.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0664_000
text:
Any poison this Pokémon takes in is converted
into a black powder and secreted. That’s why
Scatterbug can eat poisonous leaves and roots.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0665_000
text:
If Rufflet attacks this Pokémon by pecking at it,
it will retaliate with its sharp fur and poisonous
black powder.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0666_000
text:
The patterns on this Pokémon depend on the
climate and topography of the land it was born
in. This form is from frigid lands.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0666_001
text:
The patterns on this Pokémon depend on the
climate and topography of the land it was born
in. This form is from snowy lands.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0666_002
text:
The patterns on this Pokémon depend on the
climate and topography of the land it was born
in. This form is from lands of severe cold.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0666_003
text:
The patterns on this Pokémon depend on the
climate and topography of the land it was born
in. This form is from lands of vast space.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0666_004
text:
The patterns on this Pokémon depend on the
climate and topography of the land it was born
in. This form is from verdant lands.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0666_005
text:
The patterns on this Pokémon depend on the
climate and topography of the land it was born
in. This form is from lands with distinct seasons.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0666_006
text:
The patterns on this Pokémon depend on the
climate and topography of the land it was born
in. This form is from lands where flowers bloom.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0666_007
text:
The patterns on this Pokémon depend on the
climate and topography of the land it was born
in. This form is from sun-drenched lands.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0666_008
text:
The patterns on this Pokémon depend on the
climate and topography of the land it was born
in. This form is from lands with ocean breezes.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0666_009
text:
The patterns on this Pokémon depend on the
climate and topography of the land it was born
in. This form is from places with many islands.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0666_010
text:
The patterns on this Pokémon depend on the
climate and topography of the land it was born
in. This form is from lands with little rain.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0666_011
text:
The patterns on this Pokémon depend on the
climate and topography of the land it was born
in. This form is from parched lands.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0666_012
text:
The patterns on this Pokémon depend on the
climate and topography of the land it was born
in. This form is from lands where large rivers flow.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0666_013
text:
The patterns on this Pokémon depend on the
climate and topography of the land it was born
in. This form is from lands with intense rainfall.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0666_014
text:
The patterns on this Pokémon depend on the
climate and topography of the land it was born
in. This form is from lands with a tropical climate.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0666_015
text:
The patterns on this Pokémon depend on the
climate and topography of the land it was born
in. This form is from lands bathed in light.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0666_016
text:
The patterns on this Pokémon depend on the
climate and topography of the land it was born
in. This form is from lands of perpetual summer.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0666_017
text:
The patterns on this Pokémon depend on the
climate and topography of the land it was born
in. This form is from lands of tropical rain forests.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0666_018
text:
The patterns on this Pokémon depend on the
climate and topography of the land it was born
in. This form is from a mysterious land.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0666_019
text:
The patterns on this Pokémon depend on the
climate and topography of the land it was born
in. This form is from a special land.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0667_000
text:
When Litleo are young, female Pyroar will teach
them how to hunt. Once the Litleo mature, they
will leave the pride and set out on their own.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0668_000
text:
The females of a pride work together to bring
down prey. It’s thanks to them that their pride
doesn’t starve.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0669_000
text:
This Pokémon can draw forth the power hidden
within blooming wild flowers. It is particularly
fond of red flowers.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0669_001
text:
This Flabébé rides a yellow flower. The Pokémon
is defenseless and vulnerable before it has found
and received power from a flower.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0669_002
text:
This Flabébé rides an orange flower. On its
head, it wears a crown of pollen that has
healing properties.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0669_003
text:
Once it finds a flower it likes, this Pokémon will
spend the rest of its life taking care of its flower.
This Flabébé rides a blue flower.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0669_004
text:
This Flabébé rides a white flower. The wind blows
this Pokémon around as it drifts in search of
flower gardens.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0670_000
text:
This Pokémon draws forth what power is left in
withered flowers to make them healthy again.
It holds a red flower.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0670_001
text:
This Pokémon can draw forth the power hidden
within yellow flowers. This power then becomes
the moves Floette uses to protect itself.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0670_002
text:
This Pokémon can draw forth the most power
when in sync with orange flowers, compared to
flowers of other colors.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0670_003
text:
Whenever this Pokémon finds flowering plants
that are withering, it will bring them back to its
territory and care for them until they are healthy.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0670_004
text:
Floette that are fond of white flowers can also
easily sync with flowers of other colors.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0671_000
text:
This Pokémon creates an impressive flower
garden in its territory. It draws forth the power
of the red flowers around its neck.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0671_001
text:
It is said that there was once a Florges that
protected the garden of a castle for over
300 years.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0671_002
text:
Its orange flowers fire off powerful beams,
attacking as if they were a battery of artillery.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0671_003
text:
Though usually compassionate, Florges will hunt
down anyone who vandalizes its flower garden,
showing no mercy even if they beg for their lives.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0671_004
text:
A flower garden made by a white-flowered
Florges will be beautifully decorated with
flowering plants of many different colors.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0672_000
text:
Until recently, people living in the mountains
would ride on the backs of these Pokémon to
traverse the mountain paths.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0673_000
text:
It can sense the feelings of others by touching
them with its horns. This species has assisted
people with their work since 5,000 years ago.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0677_000
text:
It keeps its ears covered to prevent the intense
psychic power in its body from escaping, but it
falls unconscious if this power builds too much.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0678_000
text:
Though it has enough psychic power to blast
away any opponent, Meowstic prefers to support
its allies rather than attack.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0678_001
text:
Female Meowstic are more aggressive than
males. Their expression remains blank even
while they’re wielding immense psychic power.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0686_000
text:
It protects itself from tough foes by flashing its
luminescent spots to discourage them.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0687_000
text:
Its hypnotic powers are dangerously strong.
Anyone who falls under Malamar’s control
loses their memories surrounding the event.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0690_000
text:
Skrelp evades its enemies by hiding amid
drifting seaweed. It eats rotten seaweed to
create its poison.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0691_000
text:
Using a liquid poison, Dragalge indiscriminately
attacks anything that wanders into its territory.
This poison can corrode the undersides of boats.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0692_000
text:
This Pokémon launches water by detonating gas
inside its right claw. It snipes flying Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0693_000
text:
Clawitzer can move through the water at a speed
of 60 knots by using gas inside its body to expel
water from the back of its claw.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0700_000
text:
This Pokémon uses its ribbonlike feelers to send
a soothing aura into its opponents, erasing
their hostility.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0701_000
text:
Its elegant finishing moves—performed by nimbly
leaping around using its wings—are polished in
the forest where it was born and raised.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0702_000
text:
It’s small and its electricity-generating organ is
not fully developed, so it uses its tail to absorb
electricity from people’s homes and charge itself.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0703_000
text:
It has slept underground for hundreds of millions
of years since its birth. It’s occasionally found
during the excavation of caves.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0704_000
text:
Most of a Goomy’s body is water. A membrane
covers the whole Pokémon to prevent it from
shriveling up in dry weather.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0705_000
text:
The swirly protrusion on its back is filled with all
its vital organs, such as its brain and heart.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0706_000
text:
It loves the rain. This mellow Pokémon can be
seen walking around on the plains and in the
mountains on rainy days.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0707_000
text:
Once it absorbs a key’s metal ions, it discards the
key without a second thought. However, it will
hang on to keys it favors for decades.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0708_000
text:
Legend tells that its green leaves can cure any
illness. When plucked, however, the leaves will
instantly wither away.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0709_000
text:
Using its roots, Trevenant connects itself to trees
and monitors every corner of its forest. It uses
curses to drive intruders away.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0712_000
text:
They live in mountainous regions of frigid cold.
On rare occasions, they ride on the back of an
Avalugg to cross seas and move to new habitats.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0713_000
text:
As Avalugg walks along with Bergmite on its back,
it comes across pods of Cetitan. It lets them pass
to avoid conflict.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0714_000
text:
This Pokémon emits ultrasonic waves from its
large ears to search for fruit to eat. It mistakes
Applin for its food.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0715_000
text:
Ultrasonic waves emitted by a Noivern can
pulverize a large boulder. This Pokémon has
a cruel disposition.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0722_000
text:
Silently it glides, streaking toward its targets to
get close to them. Before they even notice it,
it begins to pelt them with vicious kicks.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0723_000
text:
This narcissistic Pokémon is a clean freak.
If you don’t groom it diligently, it may stop
listening to you.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0724_000
text:
It cunningly conceals arrow quills in its wings. It
launches these quills with such precision that they
can pierce a pebble at over a hundred yards.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0725_000
text:
If you try too hard to get close to it, it won’t
open up to you. Even if you do grow close,
giving it too much affection is still a no-no.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0726_000
text:
At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings
brightly whenever fire spews out.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0727_000
text:
When its fighting spirit is set alight, the flames
around its waist become especially intense.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0728_000
text:
This Pokémon can control balloons made of
water. It practices diligently so it can learn to
make big balloons.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0729_000
text:
A skillful dancer, it creates a sequence of water
balloons as it dances, then briskly bombards its
enemies.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0730_000
text:
To Primarina, every battle is a stage. It takes
down its prey with beautiful singing and dancing.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0731_000
text:
Using its beak to strike 16 times per second,
it opens holes in even the hardest of trees.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0732_000
text:
It flies around using a hundred different cries in
various ways to declare its territory to others.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0733_000
text:
The compressed gas in Toucannon’s beak
launches seeds with such force that they can
shatter large boulders.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0734_000
text:
Its stomach fills most of its torso. It wanders the
same path every day, searching for fresh food.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0735_000
text:
Once it finds signs of prey, it will patiently stake
out the location, waiting until the sun goes down.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0736_000
text:
Grubbin normally live underground, but if they
get unearthed by Hoothoot, they may be found
gathered around electric Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0737_000
text:
Protected by a sturdy shell, Charjabug eats large
quantities of fresh and decomposing leaf litter in
order to evolve.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0738_000
text:
Displaying exceptional mobility, it weaves
between trees and shoots down bird Pokémon
with its electromagnetic beams.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0739_000
text:
This Pokémon punches trees and eats the berries
that drop down, training itself and getting food
at the same time.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0740_000
text:
The detached pincers of these Pokémon are
delicious. Some Trainers bring Lechonk into
the mountains just to search for them.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0741_000
text:
This Pokémon is incredibly popular, possibly
because its passionate dancing is a great match
with the temperament of Paldean people.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0741_001
text:
This form of Oricorio has sipped yellow nectar.
It uses nimble steps to approach opponents,
then knocks them out with electric punches.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0741_002
text:
The airy dance of these Oricorio is popular as
a means of maintaining good health, but the
Oricorio themselves are hard to find in Paldea.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0741_003
text:
This form of Oricorio has sipped purple nectar.
It uses ethereal dance steps to call forth the
spirits of the dead.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0742_000
text:
When it senses the auras of people or Pokémon
who are having fun, it will draw close and give
them a painful poke with its long proboscis.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0743_000
text:
Ribombee can sense when people or Pokémon
are feeling down, and it will cheer them up with
handmade pollen puffs.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0744_000
text:
This Pokémon is very friendly when it’s young. Its
disposition becomes vicious once it matures, but
it never forgets the kindness of its master.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0745_000
text:
Lycanroc attacks its prey with its sharp claws and
fangs. It loyally obeys the instructions of a Trainer
it trusts.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0745_001
text:
This Pokémon uses its rocky mane to slash any
who approach. It will even disobey its Trainer
if it dislikes the orders it was given.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0745_002
text:
Normally this Pokémon doesn’t even bark, but
once it enters battle, it will relentlessly drive the
opponent into a corner.
