label: ZKN_SCARLET_0747_000
text:
This Pokémon wanders the seaside looking for
food. It often gets electric shocks from broken
Pincurchin spines that it tries to eat.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0748_000
text:
This Pokémon lives within a dome made by its
own legs. Toxapex monitors its surroundings by
sensing the flow of the tide through its spikes.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0749_000
text:
This Pokémon covers itself in mud that it has
regurgitated. The mud won’t dry out even if it’s
exposed to the sun for a long time.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0750_000
text:
This Pokémon has been treasured not just for
its physical labor but also because it produces
high-quality mud used for making pottery.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0751_000
text:
Dewpider uses sticky threads to create the water
bubble that covers its head, so the bubble very
rarely bursts.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0752_000
text:
A caring Pokémon, Araquanid carries Dewpider
around inside its water bubble to protect them as
it walks. It protects its food in its bubble too.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0753_000
text:
Fomantis hates having its naps interrupted. It fires
off beams using energy it gathers by bathing in
the sun.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0754_000
text:
By masquerading as a bug Pokémon, it lowers the
guard of actual bug Pokémon lured in by a scent
of sweet flowers. Its sickles bring them down.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0757_000
text:
It taunts its prey and lures them into narrow,
rocky areas where it then sprays them with toxic
gas to make them dizzy and take them down.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0758_000
text:
Salazzle makes its opponents light-headed with
poisonous gas, then captivates them with alluring
movements to turn them into loyal servants.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0761_000
text:
Its sweat is sweet, like syrup made from boiled-
down fruit. Because of this, Bounsweet was highly
valued in the past, when sweeteners were scarce.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0762_000
text:
Steenee spreads a sweet scent that makes others
feel invigorated. This same scent is popular for
antiperspirants.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0763_000
text:
This Pokémon is proud and aggressive. However,
it is said that a Tsareena will instantly become
calm if someone touches the crown on its calyx.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0764_000
text:
It uses its vine to pick flowers. The flowers that
Comfey attaches to itself develop healing
properties.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0765_000
text:
People used to mistake Oranguru for a human
when they saw it issue command after command
to the other Pokémon of the forest.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0766_000
text:
This Pokémon battles by throwing hard berries.
It won’t obey a Trainer who throws Poké Balls
without skill.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0769_000
text:
If it loses its shovel, it will stick something else—
like a branch—in its head to make do until it finds
another shovel.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0770_000
text:
The terrifying Palossand drags smaller Pokémon
into its sandy body. Once its victims are trapped,
it drains them of their vitality whenever it pleases.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0774_000
text:
This Pokémon is born in the ozone layer. It falls
to the ground once the outer shell enclosing its
core grows heavy.

Minior that fall to the ground try to return to
space, but their wish will not come true—all they
can do is fade away.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0775_000
text:
Komala spends its entire life sleeping. It feeds on
leaves that contain a potent poison only Komala
can break down.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0778_000
text:
This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by
sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides
itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0778_001
text:
Even as it struggles beneath the cloth to repair
the broken neck of its disguise, Mimikyu keeps
up its impersonation of Pikachu.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0779_000
text:
It grinds its teeth with great force to stimulate
its brain. It fires the psychic energy created by
this process from the protuberance on its head.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0782_000
text:
The scale atop its head is useful for both offense
and defense. It bravely stands and faces its foes
rather than turning tail, even if its foes are strong.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0783_000
text:
It gets into fistfights so intense that the scales
on its arms peel off. Bare arms are a sign of
valiance.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0784_000
text:
It lets its arm hang, and then—quick as a flash—
swings upward to land its specialty punch and
send the opponent flying high into the sky.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0810_000
text:
The stick Grookey holds has grown harder and
more flexible after soaking in the energy that
emanates from inside Grookey’s body.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0811_000
text:
It skillfully uses its two sticks not only for
drumming out rapid beats but also for
pummeling opponents during battle.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0812_000
text:
Though it has a calm disposition, it won’t tolerate
those who drum up discord. It strictly disciplines
offenders until they learn their lesson.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0813_000
text:
Once its body has heated up, Scorbunny can use
the full extent of its power. That’s why it does
warm-up exercises.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0814_000
text:
Thanks to its soft and fluffy fur, Raboot can easily
heat up its fire energy and produce flames with
more power.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0815_000
text:
Although Cinderace loses its cool easily, it will
battle flawlessly for a Trainer it trusts.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0816_000
text:
It gets berries to eat by shooting them down
with bullets of water it spurts from its mouth.
Its aim is perfect.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0817_000
text:
It extends its long, slimy tongue at blinding
speeds and finishes off its prey with great skill.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0818_000
text:
It uses special lenses in its eyes to sense things
about its opponents—like their body heat—then
attacks once it identifies a weak spot.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0819_000
text:
It stores berries in its cheeks. When there are no
berries to be found, Skwovet will stuff pebbles
into its cheeks to stave off its cravings.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0820_000
text:
If it spots a berry tree, it will immediately go to
gather berries without a sideways glance—even if
it’s in the middle of a battle.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0821_000
text:
This Pokémon is brave and reckless. The white
markings around a Rookidee’s eyes intimidate
fainthearted Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0822_000
text:
It’s said that the reason behind Corvisquire’s high
level of intelligence is the large size of its brain
relative to those of other bird Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0823_000
text:
Corviknight can’t serve as a taxi service in Paldea
because the Pokémon’s natural predators will
attack it while it flies, endangering the customer.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0833_000
text:
Its large front tooth is still growing in. When the
tooth itches, this Pokémon will bite another
Chewtle’s horn, and the two Pokémon will tussle.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0834_000
text:
Its massive, jagged teeth can crush a boulder in
a single bite. This Pokémon has an extremely
vicious disposition.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0837_000
text:
On sunny days, Rolycoly will come out onto
grassy plains and roll around. Then it will eat
the grass that gets tangled in its wheel-like leg.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0838_000
text:
The temperature inside its body increases when
it experiences strong emotions. It rolls around
frantically while spewing flames.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0839_000
text:
To intimidate its opponents, Coalossal will
vigorously shake its body, scattering coal from
its smoldering back.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0840_000
text:
It grows by eating the flesh of an apple.
Applin uses its own body fluid to strengthen
the apple’s skin and prevent it from rotting.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0841_000
text:
It flutters around while seeking an opening in
the opponent’s guard, then attacks by spitting
acidic liquid strong enough to melt metal.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0842_000
text:
It feeds mainly on sweet apples. It will also eat
small bug Pokémon that are attracted by its
sweet nectar.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0843_000
text:
Silicobra’s neck pouch, which can inflate and
deflate like a balloon, gets more elastic each
time Silicobra sheds its skin.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0844_000
text:
It will expand its body as much as it can and then
contract itself, blasting out sand with enough
force to wash away a dump truck.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0845_000
text:
Cramorant instinctively swallow everything whole.
They’re at their most formidable when they’re
struggling to swallow overly large prey.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0845_001
text:
Cramorant is constantly on the hunt for food
along riverbanks. It loves Arrokuda—when it finds
them, it swallows them whole without a thought.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0845_002
text:
Its throat is clearly not wide enough to swallow a
Pikachu, and yet Cramorant makes no move to
release its catch.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0846_000
text:
Arrokuda can swim quickly only in a straight line.
The ones that become sluggish from overeating
are the first to be targeted by flocks of Wattrel.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0847_000
text:
It spins its tail fins to leap from the water, then
viciously bites down on Wingull flying close to
the water’s surface.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0848_000
text:
It has no problem drinking dirty water.
An organ inside Toxel’s body filters such water
into a poisonous liquid that is harmless to Toxel.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0849_000
text:
As it scatters toxic sweat and emits electricity,
a melody that sounds like it came from a guitar
reverberates through the surrounding area.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0849_001
text:
Many youths admire the way this Pokémon
listlessly picks fights and keeps its cool no
matter what opponent it faces.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0854_000
text:
The soul of someone who died alone possessed
some leftover tea. This Pokémon appears in
hotels and houses.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0854_001
text:
Some fanatics will go to great pains to prepare
the perfect tea and teacup, eagerly waiting for
a Sinistea to come and possess their selections.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0855_000
text:
The tea that composes Polteageist’s body has a
distinct and enjoyable flavor. Drinking too much,
however, can be fatal.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0855_001
text:
Apparently a Polteageist’s disposition is affected
by the type of tea the Pokémon came from.
What teapot it inhabits makes no difference.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0856_000
text:
Because the emotions of others constantly flow
into its head, this Pokémon prefers environments
where no other creatures live.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0857_000
text:
To this Pokémon, strong emotions apparently feel
like incredibly loud noises—even if the emotions
are happy ones.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0858_000
text:
Hatterene knocks out those that intrude in its
home forest by blasting them with a beam, then
slashing with claws enhanced by psychic power.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0859_000
text:
The reason this Pokémon causes trouble for those
it feels close to is because Impidimp itself gets
irritable if it can’t absorb negative emotions.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0860_000
text:
Morgrem prefers dirty tactics, like ambushing,
because it doesn’t have confidence in its brawn.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0861_000
text:
This Pokémon has complete control over its hair.
Grimmsnarl normally keeps its hair wrapped
around its body to support its muscles.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0868_000
text:
The more sweet aromas it absorbs, the more its
body swells. Milcery will deflate when its energy
level drops.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0869_000
text:
Desserts that Alcremie have decorated with
their cream have a rich, sweet flavor and bring
happiness to all who eat them.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0869_001
text:
Slight vibrations shook its cells when it evolved,
giving it a sweet and tart flavor.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0869_002
text:
Slight vibrations shook its cells when it evolved,
giving it an aromatic flavor.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0869_003
text:
Slight vibrations shook its cells when it evolved,
giving it a refreshing flavor.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0869_004
text:
Slight vibrations shook its cells when it evolved,
giving it a sour flavor.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0869_005
text:
Slight vibrations shook its cells when it evolved,
giving it a salty flavor.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0869_006
text:
Slight vibrations shook its cells when it evolved,
giving it a mixed flavor.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0869_007
text:
Slight vibrations shook its cells when it evolved,
giving it a bitter flavor.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0869_008
text:
Slight vibrations shook its cells when it evolved,
giving it a complex flavor.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0870_000
text:
The brass, which is the one that stands at the
front and issues orders, is the strongest and
smartest of the six.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0871_000
text:
This Pokémon generates electricity when it
digests food. It uses its five hard teeth to scrape
seaweed off surfaces and eat it.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0872_000
text:
It eats snow that has accumulated on the ground.
It prefers soft, freshly fallen snow, so it will eat its
way up a mountain, aiming for the peak.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0873_000
text:
Frosmoth senses air currents with its antennae.
It sends its scales drifting on frigid air, making
them fall like snow.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0874_000
text:
The elemental composition of the rocks that form
its body were found to match the bedrock of a
land far away from this Pokémon’s habitat.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0875_000
text:
On hot days, these Pokémon press their ice cube
heads together and pass the time cooling each
other down.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0875_001
text:
The ice that was covering this Eiscue’s face has
shattered. Eiscue emits cold air from the tip of its
hair to protect its head, which is sensitive to heat.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0876_000
text:
This Pokémon picks up on the positive emotions
of other creatures via its horns and uses those
emotions to fuel itself.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0876_001
text:
It dislikes conflict. If a fight occurs in its territory,
it uses psychic power to throw things at the
combatants in an effort to drive them away.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0877_000
text:
Morpeko eats seeds constantly to keep its hunger
at bay. If it’s hungry for too long, it grows wild
and brutish.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0877_001
text:
Even after using up all its dark energy, this violent
ruffian will keep running riot until its hunger is
appeased.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0878_000
text:
Using the pointy tip of its trunk, it carves off
chunks of hard rocks to eat. It is very docile
and helps people with physical labor.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0879_000
text:
This Pokémon was brought to Paldea long ago by
people from a faraway land. It’s so strong that it
can easily pull an airplane.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0884_000
text:
Duraludon’s body is comprised of a special metal
that’s lightweight and scratch resistant. It’s also
smooth, as though it was given a mirror finish.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0885_000
text:
In the evening, groups of Dreepy will fly at high
speeds over the ocean and poke at Pokémon in
the water for fun.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0886_000
text:
This Pokémon flies around at over 120 miles per
hour. If a Drakloak is defeated in a battle, its
Dreepy will wander off without a second thought.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0887_000
text:
Dragapult can make its whole body transparent
by clearing its mind and focusing. Even the
Dreepy in Dragapult’s horns become invisible.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0902_000
text:
This Pokémon is cloaked in the souls of its
comrades who perished during a punishing
journey to the river of their birth.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0902_001
text:
The souls of its comrades cloak its body and
propel it effortlessly through even raging rapids.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0906_000
text:
Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants.
This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep
it from drying out.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0907_000
text:
Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath
its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against
its opponents.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0908_000
text:
This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining its
cape to camouflage the stem of its flower,
creating the illusion that the flower is floating.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0909_000
text:
It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed
by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0910_000
text:
The combination of Crocalor’s fire energy and
overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped
fireball to appear on the Pokémon’s head.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0911_000
text:
The fiery bird changes shape when Skeledirge
sings. Rumor has it that the bird was born when
the fireball on Skeledirge’s head gained a soul.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0912_000
text:
This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant
lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers
repels water and grime.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0913_000
text:
These Pokémon constantly run through shallow
waters to train their legs, then compete with each
other to see which of them kicks most gracefully.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0914_000
text:
A single kick from a Quaquaval can send a truck
rolling. This Pokémon uses its powerful legs to
perform striking dances from far-off lands.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0915_000
text:
It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen
sense of smell but doesn’t use it for anything
other than foraging.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0916_000
text:
Oinkologne is proud of its fine, glossy skin.
It emits a concentrated scent from the tip of
its tail.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0916_001
text:
This Pokémon sends a flowerlike scent wafting
about. Well-developed muscles in its legs allow it
to leap more than 16 feet with no trouble at all.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0917_000
text:
The ball of threads wrapped around its body is
elastic enough to deflect the scythes of Scyther,
this Pokémon’s natural enemy.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0918_000
text:
It clings to branches and ceilings using its threads
and moves without a sound. It takes out its prey
before the prey even notices it.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0919_000
text:
It has its third set of legs folded up. When it’s in
a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet
using the strength of its legs.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0920_000
text:
When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its
previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode.
It neutralizes its enemies in short order.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0921_000
text:
It has underdeveloped electric sacs on its cheeks.
These sacs can produce electricity only if Pawmi
rubs them furiously with the pads on its forepaws.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0922_000
text:
When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first
to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a
fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0923_000
text:
This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once
it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies
with lightning-fast movements.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0924_000
text:
Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors
to cut pieces out of any material that might be
useful for a nest, then make off with them.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0925_000
text:
They build huge nests with many rooms that
are used for different purposes, such as eating
and sleeping.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0925_001
text:
The two little ones just appeared one day.
The group might be a family of related Pokémon,
but nobody knows for sure.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0926_000
text:
This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch.
Yeast in Fidough’s breath induces fermentation in
the Pokémon’s vicinity.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0927_000
text:
The pleasant aroma that emanates from this
Pokémon’s body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun
has been treasured by farming villages.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0928_000
text:
It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil
from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and
astringent enough to make someone flinch.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0929_000
text:
Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with
others. This species has coexisted with humans
since times long gone.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0930_000
text:
This calm Pokémon is very compassionate.
It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil
with weakened Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0931_000
text:
These Pokémon prefer to live in cities. They form
flocks based on the color of their feathers, and
they fight over territory.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0931_001
text:
The largest of their flocks can contain more
than 50 individuals. They fly around towns and
forests, searching for food and making a racket.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0931_002
text:
These Squawkabilly are hotheaded, and their
fighting style is vicious. They’ll leap within reach
of their foes to engage in close combat.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0931_003
text:
This Pokémon dislikes being alone. It has a strong
sense of community and survives by cooperating
with allies.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0932_000
text:
It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the
earth. This species was particularly treasured in
the old days, as they would share precious salt.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0933_000
text:
This Pokémon dry cures its prey by spraying salt
over them. The curing process steals away the
water in the prey’s body.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0934_000
text:
Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and
sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe
wounds will promptly heal afterward.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0935_000
text:
Burnt charcoal came to life and became a
Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit,
Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0936_000
text:
Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of
armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior.
This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0937_000
text:
The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the
lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell
before accomplishing their goal.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0938_000
text:
Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity.
If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on
and off to alert its allies.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0939_000
text:
When this Pokémon expands and contracts its
wobbly body, the belly-button dynamo in its
stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0940_000
text:
When its wings catch the wind, the bones within
produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the
ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0941_000
text:
Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its
electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can
fly over 430 miles in a day.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0942_000
text:
It always scowls in an attempt to make opponents
take it seriously, but even crying children will
burst into laughter when they see Maschiff’s face.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0943_000
text:
This Pokémon can store energy in its large
dewlap. Mabosstiff unleashes this energy all
at once to blow away enemies.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0944_000
text:
Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will sink its
sharp, poison-soaked front teeth into any that
anger it, causing paralysis in the object of its ire.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0945_000
text:
The color of the poisonous saliva depends on
what the Pokémon eats. Grafaiai covers its fingers
in its saliva and draws patterns on trees in forests.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0946_000
text:
A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was
blown around by the wind until it got tangled
up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0947_000
text:
It will open the branches of its head to envelop
its prey. Once it absorbs all the life energy it
needs, it expels the prey and discards it.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0948_000
text:
Toedscool lives in muggy forests. The flaps that
fall from its body are chewy and very delicious.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0949_000
text:
These Pokémon gather into groups and form
colonies deep within forests. They absolutely
hate it when strangers approach.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0950_000
text:
Klawf hangs upside-down from cliffs, waiting for
prey. But Klawf can’t remain in this position for
long because its blood rushes to its head.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0951_000
text:
The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the
more spicy chemicals are produced by its body,
and thus the spicier its moves become.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0952_000
text:
The red head converts spicy chemicals into fire
energy and blasts the surrounding area with a
super spicy stream of flame.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0953_000
text:
This Pokémon creates a mud ball by mixing sand
and dirt with psychic energy. It treasures its mud
ball more than its own life.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0954_000
text:
The body that supports the ball barely moves.
Therefore, it is thought that the true body of this
Pokémon is actually inside the ball.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0955_000
text:
Flittle’s toes levitate about half an inch above
the ground because of the psychic power
emitted from the frills on the Pokémon’s belly.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0956_000
text:
It immobilizes opponents by bathing them in
psychic power from its large eyes. Despite its
appearance, it has a vicious temperament.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0957_000
text:
It swings its handmade hammer around to protect
itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon
that eat metal.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0958_000
text:
This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and
Bisharp, gathering metal from them in order to
create a large and sturdy hammer.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0959_000
text:
This intelligent Pokémon has a very daring
disposition. It knocks rocks into the sky with
its hammer, aiming for flying Corviknight.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0960_000
text:
This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza
just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in
the sand.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0961_000
text:
It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its
appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies
around prey, then drags the prey into its den.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0962_000
text:
It gathers things up in an apron made from shed
feathers added to the Pokémon’s chest feathers,
then drops those things from high places for fun.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0963_000
text:
It likes playing with others of its kind using the
water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to
sense the emotions of other living creatures.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0964_000
text:
This Pokémon changes its appearance if it hears
its allies calling for help. Palafin will never show
anybody its moment of transformation.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0964_001
text:
This Pokémon’s ancient genes have awakened.
It is now so extraordinarily strong that it can
easily lift a cruise ship with one fin.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0965_000
text:
It is said that this Pokémon was born when an
unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited
an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0966_000
text:
It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from
rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders—
now numbering eight—to generate energy.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0967_000
text:
Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to
ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of
this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0968_000
text:
When attacked, this Pokémon will wield the
tendrils on its body like fists and pelt the
opponent with a storm of punches.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0969_000
text:
It absorbs nutrients from cave walls. The petals
it wears are made of crystallized poison.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0970_000
text:
When this Pokémon detects danger, it will open
up its crystalline petals and fire beams from its
conical body.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0971_000
text:
It is said that a dog Pokémon that died in the
wild without ever interacting with a human was
reborn as this Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0972_000
text:
Houndstone spends most of its time sleeping
in graveyards. Among all the dog Pokémon, this
one is most loyal to its master.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0973_000
text:
This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck
into a knot so that energy stored in its belly does
not escape from its beak.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0974_000
text:
This species left the ocean and began living on
land a very long time ago. It seems to be closely
related to Wailmer.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0975_000
text:
This Pokémon wanders around snowy, icy areas.
It protects its body with powerful muscles and
a thick layer of fat under its skin.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0976_000
text:
When Veluza discards unnecessary flesh, its mind
becomes honed and its psychic power increases.
The spare flesh has a mild but delicious flavor.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0977_000
text:
This Pokémon is a glutton, but it’s bad at getting
food. It teams up with a Tatsugiri to catch prey.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0978_000
text:
This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the
mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies
on the outside.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0978_001
text:
This species’ differing colors and patterns are
apparently the result of Tatsugiri changing itself
to suit the preferences of the prey it lures in.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0978_002
text:
Bird Pokémon are its main prey. This Pokémon
knows it’s weak, so it hunts with a partner.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0979_000
text:
When its anger rose beyond a critical point, this
Pokémon gained power that is unfettered by the
limits of its physical body.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0980_000
text:
When attacked, this Pokémon will retaliate by
sticking thick spines out from its body. It’s a risky
move that puts everything on the line.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0981_000
text:
Now that the brain waves from the head and
tail are synced up, the psychic power of this
Pokémon is 10 times stronger than Girafarig’s.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0982_000
text:
This Pokémon uses its hard tail to make its nest
by boring holes into bedrock deep underground.
The nest can reach lengths of over six miles.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0982_001
text:
The gentle Dudunsparce will put Pokémon that
wander into its nest onto its back and carry them
to the entrance.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0983_000
text:
Only a Bisharp that stands above all others in its
vast army can evolve into Kingambit.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0984_000
text:
Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent
years. The name Great Tusk was taken from a
creature listed in a certain book.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0985_000
text:
There has been only one reported sighting of this
Pokémon. It resembles a mysterious creature
depicted in an old expedition journal.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0986_000
text:
It is possible that the creature listed as
Brute Bonnet in a certain book could
actually be this Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0987_000
text:
This Pokémon has characteristics similar to those
of Flutter Mane, a creature mentioned in a
certain book.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0988_000
text:
This mysterious Pokémon has some similarities
to a creature that an old book introduced as
Slither Wing.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0989_000
text:
No records exist of this Pokémon being caught.
Data is lacking, but the Pokémon’s traits match
up with a creature shown in an expedition journal.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0990_000
text:
This Pokémon closely resembles a scientific
weapon that a paranormal magazine claimed
was sent to this planet by aliens.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0991_000
text:
Its shape is similar to a robot featured in a
paranormal magazine article. The robot was said
to have been created by an ancient civilization.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0992_000
text:
It is very similar to a cyborg covered exclusively
by a paranormal magazine. The cyborg was said
to be the modified form of a certain athlete.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0993_000
text:
It resembles a certain Pokémon introduced in a
paranormal magazine, described as the offspring
of a Hydreigon that fell in love with a robot.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0994_000
text:
This Pokémon resembles an unknown object
described in a paranormal magazine as a UFO
sent to observe humanity.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0995_000
text:
It has some similarities to a Pokémon introduced
in a dubious magazine as a Tyranitar from one
billion years into the future.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0996_000
text:
Frigibax absorbs heat through its dorsal fin and
converts the heat into ice energy. The higher the
temperature, the more energy Frigibax stores.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0997_000
text:
Arctibax freezes the air around it, protecting its
face with an ice mask and turning its dorsal fin
into a blade of ice.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0998_000
text:
This Pokémon blasts cryogenic air out from
its mouth. This air can instantly freeze even
liquid-hot lava.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0999_000
text:
This Pokémon was born inside a treasure chest
about 1,500 years ago. It sucks the life-force
out of scoundrels who try to steal the treasure.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0999_001
text:
This Pokémon was born from passion that seeped
into a coin. It wanders, apparently seeking to
return to the treasure chest it once inhabited.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_1000_000
text:
Its body seems to be made up of 1,000 coins.
This Pokémon gets along well with others and is
quick to make friends with anybody.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_1001_000
text:
The grudge of a person punished for writing the
king’s evil deeds upon wooden tablets has clad
itself in dead leaves to become a Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_1002_000
text:
This Pokémon can control 100 tons of fallen
snow. It plays around innocently by leaping in
and out of avalanches it has caused.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_1003_000
text:
The fear poured into an ancient ritual vessel
has clad itself in rocks and dirt to become
a Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_1004_000
text:
It controls flames burning at over 5,400 degrees
Fahrenheit. It casually swims through the sea of
lava it creates by melting rock and sand.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_1005_000
text:
It is possible that this is the creature listed as
Roaring Moon in an expedition journal that still
holds many mysteries.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_1006_000
text:
It has some similarities to a mad scientist’s
invention covered in a paranormal magazine.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_1007_000
text:
This seems to be the Winged King mentioned in
an old expedition journal. It was said to have
split the land with its bare fists.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_1008_000
text:
Much remains unknown about this creature.
It resembles Cyclizar, but it is far more ruthless
and powerful.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_1009_000
text:
This ferocious creature is shrouded in mystery.
It’s named after an aquatic monster mentioned
in an old expedition journal.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_1010_000
text:
Many of its physical characteristics match those
of a Virizion from the future that was covered in
a paranormal magazine.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0901_001
text:
It crossed the sea and drifted ashore in a new
land. Surviving in this place led it to take on a
unique appearance and gain special powers.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_1011_000
text:
Dipplin is two creatures in one Pokémon.
Its evolution was triggered by a special apple
grown only in one place.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_1012_000
text:
Supposedly, the regrets of a tea ceremony master
who died before perfecting his craft lingered in
some matcha and became a Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_1012_001
text:
It sprinkles some of its powdery body onto food
and drains the life-force from those who so much
as lick it.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_1013_000
text:
It pretends to be tea, trying to fool people into
drinking it so it can drain their life-force. Its ruse
is generally unsuccessful.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_1013_001
text:
It lives inside a superb teacup that was crafted
by a potter of great renown. Collectors positively
adore this Pokémon.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_1014_000
text:
After all its muscles were stimulated by the toxic
chain around its neck, Okidogi transformed and
gained a powerful physique.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_1015_000
text:
The chain is made from toxins that enhance
capabilities. It stimulated Munkidori’s brain and
caused the Pokémon’s psychic powers to bloom.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_1016_000
text:
Fezandipiti owes its beautiful looks and lovely
voice to the toxic stimulants emanating from the
chain wrapped around its body.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_1017_000
text:
This Pokémon’s type changes based on which
mask it’s wearing. It confounds its enemies with
nimble movements and kicks.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_1017_001
text:
This form excels in both attack and defense.
It ceaselessly unleashes moves like a spring
gushes water.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_1017_002
text:
This form is the most aggressive, bombarding
enemies with the intensity of flames blazing
within a hearth.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_1017_003
text:
This form has excellent defenses, absorbing
impacts solidly like the cornerstones that support
houses.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_1018_000
text:
It gathers static electricity from its surroundings.
The beams it launches when down on all fours
are tremendously powerful.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_1019_000
text:
Seven syrpents live inside an apple made
of syrup. The syrpent in the center is the
commander.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_1020_000
text:
There are scant few reports of this creature
being sighted. One short video shows it
rampaging and spouting pillars of flame.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_1021_000
text:
It’s said to incinerate everything around it with
lightning launched from its fur. Very little is
known about this creature.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_1022_000
text:
It resembles a Pokémon described in a
dubious magazine as a Terrakion that had
been modified by an evil organization.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_1023_000
text:
It resembles a mysterious object introduced in a
paranormal magazine as a cutting-edge weapon
shaped like a Cobalion.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_1024_000
text:
Terapagos protects itself using its power to
transform energy into hard crystals. This Pokémon
is the source of the Terastal phenomenon.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_1024_001
text:
Upon sensing danger, it prepares itself for
battle by creating a sturdy shell of crystallized
Terastal energy.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_1024_002
text:
In this form, Terapagos resembles the world
as the ancients saw it, and its Terastal energy
is abnormally amplified.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_1025_000
text:
It feeds others toxic mochi that draw out desires
and capabilities. Those who eat the mochi fall
under Pecharunt’s control, chained to its will.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0900_000
text:
Parts of its body turned to stone when
it evolved thanks to an extremely rare
ore found in volcanic areas.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0904_000
text:
Overqwil’s poisonous spikes will reflexively react
even while Overqwil sleeps, stabbing any moving
thing that approaches.

label: ZKN_SCARLET_0211_001
text:
It lives just offshore in cold parts of the world.
Its poisonous spikes are thicker and shorter than
those of other regions’ Qwilfish.
